Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

dot yaml must cap connections at one thousand per host.", "output": "Team, here is our operational deployment and configuration audit plan for the Kubernetes Istio service mesh. Please inspect file reference `deploy/mesh/envoy_filter.yaml` and check `scripts/deploy_mesh.sh` in our infrastructure repository. Our production service mesh manages mutual TLS communication and traffic routing across 120 microservice deployments. In `envoy_filter.yaml`, verify that Lua filter configurations inject custom traceparent headers and extract tenant identifiers from incoming JWT claims. Furthermore, in `deploy_mesh.sh`, ensure that Helm deployment scripts configure sidecar proxy memory limits to 1 GB and CPU limits to 1 virtual CPU. Connection pool settings in `destination_rule.yaml` must set max connections to 2,000 and max pending requests to 500 to prevent connection starvation. In addition, outlier detection in `circuit_breaker.yaml` must eject failing proxy endpoints after 3 consecutive 5xx server errors for a duration of 30 seconds.\\n\\nSite reliability engineers must monitor service mesh proxy latency on Grafana, keeping sidecar proxy overhead strictly below 2 milliseconds p95. If an untrusted service attempts connection without valid mTLS client certificates, Envoy must immediately reject the handshake with HTTP 403 Forbidden. The platform security architect mandates that all sidecar proxies run with non-root user permissions and read-only root filesystems enforced in pod security policies. In addition, distributed tracing in `tracing_config.yaml` must configure OpenTelemetry collector endpoints sampling 10% of all inter-service requests. Resource quota allocations in `quota.yaml` must allocate 64 CPU cores and 256 GB of memory per mesh namespace. Graceful shutdown hooks in `drain_filter.yaml` must allow 60 seconds for active inflight requests to complete before terminating sidecar worker containers.\\n\\nThe network security team requires automated vulnerability scans verifying zero high-severity CVE findings in the Envoy proxy container image. In addition, mutual TLS migration rules in `peer_auth.yaml` must enforce strict mTLS mode across all production namespaces, blocking plaintext connections. The Vice President of Infrastructure mandates verified zero-downtime canary mesh upgrades simulating rolling restarts across 30 worker nodes before release. Ingress rate limiting in `ingress_limiter.yaml` must enforce token bucket throttling at 10,000 requests per second across ingress gateways. Access logging formatters in `access_log.yaml` must export structured JSON access logs including upstream cluster latency and downstream response flags. TCP keep-alive probes in `mesh_network.yaml` must configure socket keep-alives with 60-second intervals to detect stale TCP connections. Sidecar injection webhooks in `injection_webhook.yaml` must automatically inject Envoy proxy containers into pods labeled with istio-injection enabled. Egress gateway routing in `egress_rule.yaml` must restrict outbound internet traffic, forcing external API calls through dedicated egress proxy pods.\\n\\nCertificate rotation daemons in `cert_rotator.sh` must renew internal SPIRE TLS certificates every 24 hours without dropping active connections. Canary rollout controllers in `rollout_controller.yaml` must orchestrate progressive traffic shifts in 10% increments based on error rate metrics. The Chief Security Officer mandates automated audit logging of all administrative mesh configuration changes to immutable S3 security logs. Istio control plane monitors in `pilot_monitor.yaml` must track xDS push latency, keeping distribution delays below 500 milliseconds. Sidecar CPU throttling alerts in `throttle_alert.yaml` must trigger Slack notifications whenever container CPU throttling exceeds 5%. Envoy access log filtering in `log_filter.yaml` must exclude health probe endpoints from access logs, reducing log ingestion volume. Traffic splitting rules in `split_rule.yaml` must support canary traffic weight adjustments without requiring sidecar container restarts. Service account token projections in `token_projection.yaml` must mount short-lived service account tokens with 1-hour expiration.\\n\\nThe infrastructure security lead mandates quarterly external audits of all Istio RBAC authorization policies across production clusters. Envoy connection drain timeouts in `drain_timeout.yaml` must allow 30 seconds for active connections to terminate during graceful restarts. Sidecar resource limits in `limit_config.yaml` must enforce strict memory thresholds preventing node memory pressure. Envoy access log formatting in `access_log_format.yaml` must capture upstream service names and cluster response times. Canary deployment automation in `canary_deploy.sh` must verify zero HTTP 5xx responses before promoting mesh routing rules to production. Envoy TLS certificate metrics in `cert_metrics.yaml` must track days until certificate expiry, alerting when expiration is under 7 days. Circuit breaker trip counters in `breaker_metrics.yaml` must record total trip events per upstream service. Upstream cluster connection limits in `cluster_config.yaml` must cap connections at 1,000 per host."}]
